sections.title: Probation of Offenders Act, 1958 and section 401 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, not to apply.
sections.text_before_subsections: The provisions of the Probation of Offenders Act, 1958 (20 of 1958) and section 401 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (46 of 2023) shall not apply to a person convicted of an offence under this Act unless that person is under eighteen years of age.
